name: openFDA Food Enforcement API
category: Food and beverages
use_case: Pull classified FDA food recall enforcement records and match by brand, product description, firm, reason, distribution, and dates.
limitations: May lag public alerts; not every public notice has a press release; recall status may not be updated after classification.

name: FDA Recalls, Market Withdrawals & Safety Alerts
category: Food, drugs, supplements, cosmetics, and medical devices
use_case: Parse current FDA-regulated product recalls, withdrawals, and safety alerts across product types.
limitations: Only recent years appear on the page before archive; not all recalls have press releases.

name: FDA Food Alerts, Advisories & Safety Information
category: Food, beverages, dietary supplements, and infant formula
use_case: Capture public food advisories, safety alerts, and public health alerts that may appear before structured enforcement records.
limitations: Mixed notice formats; some notices involve imported products but are U.S. consumer alerts.

name: openFDA Drug Enforcement API
category: Medicines, OTC drugs, prescription drugs, and supplements
use_case: Pull FDA drug recall enforcement records and match by brand, generic name, firm, NDC when present, lot, and reason.
limitations: Classified enforcement data can lag public notices; not a medical advice source.

name: openFDA Drug NDC API
category: Medicines, OTC drugs, and prescription drugs
use_case: Normalize NDCs and connect drug products to labelers, marketing status, packaging, labels, recalls, and adverse-event sources.
limitations: NDC listing does not mean FDA approval or safety; labeler-submitted content may be incomplete.

name: FDA NDC Directory
category: Medicines, OTC drugs, and prescription drugs
use_case: Use as canonical NDC reference and fallback when openFDA mappings are incomplete.
limitations: NDC presence is not approval; excludes some products and package cases.

name: openFDA Drug Label API
category: Medicines, OTC drugs, and prescription drugs
use_case: Retrieve official drug label sections such as warnings, active ingredients, contraindications, and dosage for reports.
limitations: Labels are not recall signals and do not replace clinician guidance.

name: openFDA Drug Adverse Event / FAERS API
category: Medicines, OTC drugs, prescription drugs, and supplements
use_case: Show aggregate adverse-event signal context for matched drugs with strong caveats.
limitations: Voluntary reports, duplicates, confounding, and reporting bias; not incidence data or causality.

name: openFDA Cosmetic Adverse Event API
category: Cosmetics and personal care products
use_case: Provide adverse-event context for personal care and cosmetic products or brands.
limitations: Adverse reports are not recalls and do not prove causation; product identity may be inconsistent.

name: CAERS / openFDA Food Event API
category: Food, beverages, supplements, and cosmetics
use_case: Add adverse-event context for supplements, foods, and cosmetics after recall matching is working.
limitations: Voluntary reports, duplicates, weak product normalization, and no causality.

name: openFDA Device Recall API
category: Medical devices
use_case: Match medical devices by product code, device name, manufacturer, and recall number.
limitations: Device identity can be hard without UDI; data may lag public notices.

name: openFDA Device Enforcement API
category: Medical devices
use_case: Add classified enforcement records to device safety checks.
limitations: Not every device notice is easy to match from consumer text.

name: openFDA Device Event / MAUDE API
category: Medical devices
use_case: Provide adverse-event signal context for matched device types, manufacturers, and model names.
limitations: Reports are not incidence or causality data; duplicate and noisy records are expected.

name: openFDA Device UDI API
category: Medical devices
use_case: Normalize UDI-DI, manufacturer, brand, version/model, and device descriptions.
limitations: UDI must be captured accurately; not every older device has complete UDI data.

name: USDA FSIS Recall API
category: Meat, poultry, and egg products
use_case: Pull FSIS recalls and public health alerts for meat, poultry, and egg products.
limitations: Endpoint should be manually verified before implementation; FSIS jurisdiction excludes many FDA-regulated foods.

name: USDA FSIS Recalls & Public Health Alerts
category: Meat, poultry, and egg products
use_case: Use as public notice fallback and source of narrative details, labels, establishment numbers, and photos.
limitations: HTML/PDF details vary; not a universal food recall source.

name: USDA FoodData Central API
category: Food and beverages
use_case: Enrich food product identity and branded food matching with FDC identifiers, ingredients, and nutrients.
limitations: Requires API key; nutrition database is not a recall database; branded coverage varies.

name: CPSC Recalls API
category: Appliances, electronics, batteries, toys, furniture, mattresses, home goods, personal care appliances, and household products
use_case: First V1 recall adapter for consumer products; match by product name, brand, model, hazard, remedy, dates, and manufacturer.
limitations: Categories can be broad; model and serial fields may require detail-page parsing.

name: CPSC recall detail pages
category: Appliances, electronics, kids products, furniture, home goods, and household chemicals
use_case: Fetch detail pages for evidence snippets, model numbers, affected units, images, incidents, and remedy instructions.
limitations: HTML structure can change; some details are in narrative text.

name: NHTSA Recalls API / datasets
category: Cars, VINs, tires, car seats, and vehicle equipment
use_case: Build vehicle recall adapter by year/make/model, campaign, component, and VIN-derived metadata.
limitations: API by vehicle needs year/make/model; VIN-specific open recall status may require portal or manufacturer lookup.

name: NHTSA vPIC VIN Decoder API
category: VINs and vehicle identity
use_case: Decode VINs to normalize vehicle make, model, model year, body class, and other identity fields before recall matching.
limitations: VIN decode is identity, not recall status; malformed VINs need validation.

name: NHTSA recall search portal
category: Cars, tires, car seats, and vehicle equipment
use_case: Link users to official VIN, vehicle, tire, car seat, and equipment recall checks as verification fallback.
limitations: Portal may be interactive; scraping VIN results can be restricted.

name: DailyMed API
category: Medicines, OTC drugs, and prescription drugs
use_case: Retrieve official SPL label sections, PDFs, NDCs, RxCUIs, packaging, and media for medication reports.
limitations: Label data is not recall or adverse-event data; only as current as submitted labels.

name: RxNorm / RxNav API
category: Medicines, OTC drugs, and prescription drugs
use_case: Normalize drug names, ingredients, brands, RxCUIs, and aliases before matching FDA/NLM sources.
limitations: Does not cover all supplements or non-drug products; terminology matching still needs caution.

name: AccessGUDID API
category: Medical devices
use_case: Match UDI-DI to device brand, version/model, company, and identifiers.
limitations: Developer URL and current API shape should be manually verified before implementation.

name: EPA CompTox Chemicals Dashboard APIs
category: Household chemicals, cleaning products, and ingredients
use_case: Normalize chemical ingredient names and identifiers for household chemical reports.
limitations: API documentation URL should be manually verified; not a recall source and not consumer risk scoring by itself.

name: EPA Safer Choice product list
category: Household chemicals and cleaning products
use_case: Enrich household-cleaner reports with Safer Choice certification status where relevant.
limitations: Certification is not a recall or safety guarantee; product list can have multiple entries per product.

name: Recalls.gov
category: Cross-category recalls
use_case: Use as a user-facing fallback and source coverage explainer across major U.S. recall agencies.
limitations: Aggregator/link portal, not a complete structured API.

name: FoodSafety.gov
category: Food and beverages
use_case: Use as food recall coverage explanation and fallback link in reports.
limitations: Widget/source details may be embedded; not a canonical API for all food recalls.

name: Costco recalls
category: Food, supplements, appliances, electronics, and home goods
use_case: Match Costco item numbers, brand names, and retail-specific notices for user-owned products.
limitations: Retailer-specific; page structure may change; not all sold products are covered.

name: Sam's Club recalls
category: Food, supplements, appliances, electronics, and home goods
use_case: Link users to retailer notices and match Member's Mark or Sam's Club retail products.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; help-center pages can change.

name: Walmart recalls
category: Food, OTC, supplements, appliances, electronics, and home goods
use_case: Match Walmart private-label products, UPCs, and retail notices.
limitations: Retailer-specific; may duplicate FDA and CPSC notices.

name: Target recalls
category: Food, kids products, home goods, electronics, and personal care
use_case: Match Target private-label products and link users to retailer return or remedy instructions.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; dynamic help URLs may change.

name: Amazon product safety / recalls
category: Cross-category marketplace products
use_case: Use as a future user-directed link for order-specific recall awareness.
limitations: Login/account context; scraping and order import should be skipped in V1.

name: Best Buy recalls
category: Electronics, appliances, batteries, and chargers
use_case: Match electronics and appliance recalls and provide retailer remedy links.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; page may be JavaScript-heavy.

name: Home Depot recalls
category: Appliances, heaters, tools, batteries, and home goods
use_case: Match home improvement, appliance, and tool products by brand and model.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; page may be hard to scrape.

name: Lowe's recalls
category: Appliances, heaters, tools, batteries, and home goods
use_case: Match Lowe's retail products and provide remedy or return links.
limitations: Retailer-specific; page can be dense and JavaScript-heavy.

name: Kroger recalls
category: Food, OTC, and household products
use_case: Match Kroger private-label foods by UPC, brand, and product name.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; regional banners may publish separately.

name: Trader Joe's recalls
category: Food and beverages
use_case: Match Trader Joe's private-label food products and alert users.
limitations: Dynamic page; product identifiers may be narrative text only.

name: Whole Foods recalls
category: Food, supplements, and personal care
use_case: Match Whole Foods private-label products and provide retailer-specific remedy links.
limitations: Retailer-specific; may duplicate FDA notices.

name: Samsung recalls
category: Appliances, electronics, batteries, and chargers
use_case: Match Samsung model numbers for ranges, appliances, phones, batteries, and electronics.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; product-specific support pages may vary.

name: LG recalls
category: Appliances, electronics, and batteries
use_case: Match LG model numbers for ranges, refrigerators, washers, dryers, and electronics.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; category query may change.

name: Whirlpool recalls
category: Appliances such as dryers, refrigerators, washers, and ranges
use_case: Match Whirlpool family brand and model numbers for appliances.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; brand-family pages may be split.

name: Ninja recalls
category: Air fryers, pressure cookers, and kitchen appliances
use_case: Match Ninja model numbers for pressure cookers, air fryers, blenders, and kitchen appliances.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; support-center category may change.

name: Instant Brands recalls
category: Pressure cookers, air fryers, and kitchen appliances
use_case: Match Instant Pot and related model numbers.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; ownership and site paths can change.

name: Anker recalls
category: Power banks, chargers, batteries, and electronics
use_case: Match power-bank model numbers and battery product names.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; recalls may be product-specific microsites.

name: Segway/Ninebot recalls
category: Scooters, e-bikes, batteries, and mobility products
use_case: Match scooter and e-bike model numbers and serial numbers when available.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; product-specific pages may change.

name: Toyota recalls
category: Cars, VINs, and vehicle equipment
use_case: Use as manufacturer verification link after NHTSA/vPIC identity matching.
limitations: Interactive lookup; should not be scraped without terms review.

name: Honda recalls
category: Cars, VINs, and vehicle equipment
use_case: Use as manufacturer verification link for Honda VINs.
limitations: Dynamic portal; VIN lookup automation may be restricted.

name: Ford recalls
category: Cars, VINs, and vehicle equipment
use_case: Use as manufacturer verification link for Ford and Lincoln VINs.
limitations: Dynamic portal; VIN lookup automation may be restricted.

name: GM recalls
category: Cars, VINs, and vehicle equipment
use_case: Use as manufacturer verification link for Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, and Cadillac VINs.
limitations: Dynamic page should be manually verified before implementation.

name: Tesla recalls
category: Cars, VINs, vehicle software, and vehicle equipment
use_case: Link users to official Tesla recall status after NHTSA matching.
limitations: Some recall remedies are software updates; VIN-specific state may require account or lookup.

name: Graco recalls
category: Car seats, strollers, and baby products
use_case: Match model numbers for car seats, strollers, bases, and travel systems.
limitations: Official URL should be manually verified; pages may be recall-specific forms.

name: Fisher-Price recalls
category: Baby/kids products, toys, sleepers, and furniture
use_case: Match product numbers, names, and dates for baby and kids products.
limitations: Page may include non-U.S. entries; Dav AI must filter to U.S.-relevant notices.

name: IKEA recalls
category: Furniture, mattresses, home goods, and kids products
use_case: Match IKEA product names, article numbers, furniture, and home goods categories.
limitations: Retailer/manufacturer-specific; may duplicate CPSC notices.
